docs.description: Project docs: conventions (structure, env), architecture, ADRs. Consult before writing code.

typecheck.description: Run the TypeScript compiler and fix any errors
typecheck.template: Run `npm run typecheck` and fix every type error it reports, following `docs/conventions/structure.md`.

migrate.description: Create and apply a Prisma migration
migrate.template: Create a Prisma migration named "$ARGUMENTS" using the prisma-next-migrations skill, then run `npx prisma migrate dev --name $ARGUMENTS` and `npx prisma generate`.

test.description: Run the Vitest suite and fix failures
test.template: Run `npm run test` and fix any failing tests.

deploy.template: Deploy the app to Vercel using the deploy-to-vercel skill and report the deployment URL.
